item.title: 【Albums (lossy)】Dolby Atmos - Sabrina Carpenter "Fruitcake (EP)" (Explicit) [Dolby Atmos, 5.1, 48.0 kHz, 768 kb/s]
item.description:
Sabrina Carpenter "Fruitcake (EP)" [Explicit]
Dolby Atmos Music



Fruitcake is the second extended play (EP) and first Christmas themed record by American singer Sabrina Carpenter. It was released by Island Records on November 17, 2023. It was produced by Julian Bunetta and John Ryan.
Background and release

Prior to signing with Island Records in 2021, Carpenter released various Christmas songs including "Christmas the Whole Year Round" which reached number 17 on the US Holiday Digital Song Sales chart. On December 7, 2022, following her fifth studio album Emails I Can't Send, Carpenter released a Christmas remix of the track "Nonsense", titled "A Nonsense Christmas".

A year later, on November 8, 2023, Carpenter announced that she would be releasing her first Christmas-themed EP,[5] and revealed its track list through a post on her social media accounts. The EP was released on November 17, 2023. On her website, the announcement followed the same aesthetic of her album Emails I Can't Send (2022), being presented in a designed email-style.

On November 11, 2025, she revealed two variants - Liquid Glitter and Milky Clear - which became available for pre-order the same day. Both editions are scheduled for release on December 12, 2025.
